capabilities: Paste YouTube, Instagram, or TikTok links and choose embed, title link, or plain link
Resize, edit, or remove embed blocks by dragging a handle or using hover controls
Set block options such as width, caption, start and end times, and Instagram author handle
Insert empty video blocks via a command with configurable default widths
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is via BRAT or manual download, and it requires Obsidian 1.13 or later.
motivation: The author was inspired by Notion's paste card, which offers link, bookmark, or embed choices, and by Meta AI's clean Instagram reel preview with the creator's handle.
problem: Obsidian's built-in embeds require manual iframe or embed syntax; pasting a video link gives no choice of how it is displayed.

relations.evidence: pasting a link in Notion offers to keep it as a link, turn it into a bookmark, or embed it
hovering an Instagram reel link in Meta AI shows a clean, full-bleed preview

summary: Paste helper that turns YouTube, Instagram, and TikTok links into embeds, title links, or plain links, with resizable embed blocks.
